name: focxle

tools.name: spend_summary
tools.description: What the user's AI agents cost in total over recent days, across every vendor, including model APIs and ordinary HTTP APIs. Use this for questions like 'what did my agents cost this week'.

days.description: How many recent days to include. Defaults to 7.

tools.name: spend_by_agent
tools.description: Cost broken down per agent, largest first. Use this for 'which agent is expensive', 'what is costing me the most', or comparing agents.

days.description: How many recent days to include. Defaults to 7.

tools.name: spend_by_vendor
tools.description: Cost broken down per vendor, such as anthropic, openai or an HTTP API host. Use this for 'where is the money going' or 'how much am I spending on OpenAI'.

days.description: How many recent days to include. Defaults to 7.

tools.name: what_a_cap_would_stop
tools.description: What a spending cap would have prevented, based on the policy the user already configured. Nothing was actually blocked. Use this for 'would a limit have helped' or 'how much could I have saved'.

days.description: How many recent days to include. Defaults to 7.

tools.name: focxle_status
tools.description: Whether focxle has recorded anything yet, how many days of history exist, and where it is stored. Use this first if other tools return no data.

instructions: Answers questions about what this developer's AI agents cost, from spend focxle recorded locally on this machine. Covers model APIs and ordinary HTTP APIs together, per agent. Nothing here leaves the machine. If a tool reports no data, call focxle_status first.
